units: <cite ref="Shabbat 104a:6">Sabb. 104ᵃ</cite> [read:] <he>פ״ה כפופה פ״ה פשוטה פה פתוח פה סתום</he> the curved Pé and the straight Pé (<cite ref="Q00000"><he>פ</he></cite> and <he>ף</he>) intimate: an open mouth (in due time), a closed mouth (in due time).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 104b:11">Snh. 104ᵇ</cite> <he>מפני מה הקדים פ״ה לע״ין</he> why has Pé been placed before ‘Ayin (<cite ref="Lamentations 2:16-17">Lam. II, 16-17</cite>)? <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 84:8">Gen. R. s. 84</cite> (ref. to <he>פ̇ס̇י̇ם̇</he>) <he>פ״א פוטיפר וכ׳</he> Pé intimates Potifar &c.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>פֵּיפִין</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 103b:12">Sabb. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>טיתין פ׳ פ׳ טיתין</he> one must be careful not to write Teths looking like Pés &c.
